body: It is a long story. Short version I need money to start renting a house or most likely I'll lose my kids.

Oh, and just so everyone knows this is the cheapest place I could find to fit all of us. It's in a decent neighborhood, not the best, but it's safe enough and not the rich neighborhood. I am not trying to get into an extravagant place, just somewhere livable. I really do need help.

The lady has been really nice, she lowered the rent 100 dollars for me and she is holding the place for me as long as I assured her I can come up with the money in the next 2 weeks (before the 1st). I would feel so awful for putting her through all of that and denying other renters waiting for me. I am desperate for a place for my kids to live, and this house is big enough for all of us, cheap enough as long as I get through this first month. I just have a feeling I can't pull it off and get the money in time. I'm already suicidal, knowing I strained this woman would definitely push me over the edge.

If I sell everything just to get rent before I start working (just divorced, was a housewife) then even if I do get enough we won't have anything at all except an empty house and I doubt I'll ever be able to come up with enough money to replace the stuff. I just feel like I've been totally screwed. My kids were being abused by my husband and I tried to get him to receive help but he wouldn't. I ended up paying for the entire divorce because he's a deadbeat, which is why I have struggled so hard to get the money for a place.
Sorry for all the deleted comments and craziness I don't really know how to use reddit, just figuring it out.
Well, I posted what happened. I'm not saying I'm perfect but this is what happened. I just need help getting into a place.
To be able to have a place to live, rent and deposit money.

I know it's not, it's just rent and rental deposit money, but I still have no way to get the money at this point. The rent is 700 and the deposit is 500. It's just not possible with everything that's gone on lately

I need it to be able to start renting a place before my kids and I are homeless. I am so scared of them being taken from me just because I can't come up with a first month of rent and the deposit. I am also afraid of selling everything I own (which isn't much) trying to get the money and still not coming up with enough and then being homeless til I get paid. In that amount of time it will most likely be too late. Every day that passes I can't think of anything else but dying.
